top_findings.title: No MCP protocol server — a FastAPI REST API stands in for it
top_findings.evidence: src/api.py:4 from fastapi import FastAPI; src/main.py:10 uvicorn.run(app,...); grep for import mcp/from mcp/fastmcp/Server(/list_tools/call_tool/@mcp/@app.tool across src+tests returns zero; requirements.txt has no MCP SDK.
top_findings.suggestion: Implement query functions as MCP tools via the mcp Python SDK (Server + list_tools/call_tool or fastmcp) served over stdio/SSE, not FastAPI/uvicorn HTTP.
